notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Naked Erotic Dance Girls is nearing release. The original release date was missed as it seems like COVID-19 has slowed down some of the review process.

We did hear back and had to make one small change (which is completed). The game has been re-submitted and hopefully will be live sooner than later.

We at Lewd Digital appreciate your patience. We are certain the wait will be well worth it 😉

notes.title: Possible Release Delay
notes.notes:
Naked Erotic Dance Girls may be delayed as its product review is taking longer than anticipated. Please be patient as we wait to hear back — Don't worry, these girls aren't going anywhere without you 😉

Perhaps there is still potential for the game to release on its scheduled date of October 1st, 2020. If we don't hear back by the end of day tomorrow, the release will be pushed back another week to the following Thursday, on October 8th, 2020.

In the meantime, I have gone ahead and added some achievements to the game. There are also plans for additional dancers, stages, music, and dance routines still to come.
